I regularly contribute to /v/retrofuturism and /v/historicimages, which are largely or entirely composed of links to images. Sometimes the subverse page generates thumbnails for these image URL links, and sometimes it does not. Why? Is there anything I can do to ensure that my image URL gets a thumbnail?
Only some image URLs get thumbnails. Why?
Affirmative. I am talking about .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif Image URLs, not other types of URLs (no .html, no .php).

It's not enough that the file is of the correct type -- the URL must end exactly in .jpg or whatever format it is. It won't work if it has a query string, for example image.jpg?foo=bar.

Edit: hadn't read your other comment. Query strings aren't the problem here, but I do see that issue a lot.
Yes, already considered. I expect anything that is not a "pure" URL (i.e. containing '?' or "#") would not be accommodated in the parsing algorithm. As you see, my examples are clean strings...

I think (I haven't actually tested this theory out, yet) that it has to do with how the image was posted.

Let's take Imgur, for example:

If you post directly to the image (something.tiff or jpg or b pm or whatever filename) it'll give you a thumbnail for that image.

If you post a link to an album (imgur.com/abXy97z or whatever your have) it won't give you a thumbnail.

Again, I haven't tested it, and I may be wrong, but that's the general concensus I've gotten when I browse Voat.

While I understand posting a non-image URL (without .jpg, .jpeg, .png extension) generally does not generate a thumbnail, I have real image URLs ending in .jpg and .jpeg that do not ever generate thumbnails. For example see this front page and check out links for "Water Discus Hotel" or "Ericofon". One points to a .jpeg and one to a .jpg. Neither generates a thumbnail, but the link "Sculptura Phone" (.jpg) does.
Not just odd, but annoying. Will repost on the dev thread if I get no satisfaction here.
